Script.name: GUI Boot
Script.script:
-- CRITICAL: These initialization calls MUST remain outside any function! -- Mudlet requires GUI elements to be created immediately when the script loads. -- Moving these inside GUI.init() or any other function will cause complete failure. -- The GUI background, borders, and boxes must exist before any other initialization. -- This needs to be outside the config, since YATCO needs to have the boxes set. GUI.image_location = getMudletHomeDir():gsub("\\", "/") .. "/LuminariGUI/images/" GUI.debug("BOOT/CONFIG", "Config script reached", { imageLocation = GUI.image_location, initBackground = type(GUI.init_background), setBorders = type(GUI.set_borders), initBoxes = type(GUI.init_boxes), })
-- These calls used to run unguarded before GUI.initializeOrRefresh was -- defined. Any one error aborted this entire script and produced the -- misleading "GUI system not fully loaded" message. In debug mode each -- stage now prints its entry, result, and stack trace, then allows the rest -- of the diagnostic/lifecycle functions to load. local bootStages = { {name = "GUI.init_background", callable = GUI.init_background}, {name = "GUI.set_borders", callable = GUI.set_borders}, {name = "GUI.init_boxes", callable = GUI.init_boxes}, } for _, stage in ipairs(bootStages) do local ok, result = GUI.debugCall("BOOT/CONFIG/" .. stage.name, stage.callable) GUI.debugBootResults[stage.name] = { ok = ok, result = result, } GUI.debug("BOOT/CONFIG", "stage complete", { stage = stage.name, ok = ok, result = result, }) end
function GUI.validateCoreLayout() local requiredParents = { Bottom = GUI.Bottom, chatContainer = GUI.chatContainer, chatContainerInner = GUI.chatContainerInner, buttonPanelContainer = GUI.buttonPanelContainer, roomInfoContainer = GUI.roomInfoContainer, statusGaugesContainer = GUI.Box7, } local missing = {} for name, value in pairs(requiredParents) do if type(value) ~= "table" then missing[#missing + 1] = name end end table.sort(missing) if #missing > 0 then return false, "missing core GUI parents: " .. table.concat(missing, ", ") end return true end
function GUI.init() GUI.debug("GUI/INIT", "initialization sequence starting", { alreadyInitialized = GUI.initialized, }) GUI.AffectIcons = GUI.AffectIcons or {} GUI.Affects = GUI.Affects or {} GUI.Affects.Rows = GUI.Affects.Rows or {} GUI.Affects.Modes = GUI.Affects.Modes or {}
GUI.initFailures = {} local coreReady, coreError = GUI.validateCoreLayout() if not coreReady then GUI.initFailures[1] = { stage = "GUI.validateCoreLayout", error = coreError, } GUI.initialized = false GUI.debugError("GUI/INIT/CORE", coreError) print("[GUI] Initialization stopped safely: " .. coreError) return false, coreError end
local initStages = { {name = "GUI.init_gauges", callable = GUI.init_gauges}, {name = "GUI.init_action_icons", callable = GUI.init_action_icons}, {name = "GUI.tabbedInfoWindow.init", callable = GUI.tabbedInfoWindow.init}, {name = "GUI.init_player", callable = GUI.init_player}, {name = "GUI.init_group", callable = GUI.init_group}, {name = "GUI.Affects.init", callable = GUI.Affects.init}, {name = "GUI.draw_frames", callable = GUI.draw_frames}, {name = "GUI.buttonWindow.init", callable = GUI.buttonWindow.init}, {name = "GUI.init_castConsole", callable = GUI.init_castConsole}, {name = "GUI.styleScrollbar", callable = GUI.styleScrollbar}, {name = "GUI.registerEventHandlers", callable = GUI.registerEventHandlers}, }
for _, stage in ipairs(initStages) do local ok, result = GUI.debugCall("GUI/INIT/" .. stage.name, stage.callable) if not ok then GUI.initFailures[#GUI.initFailures + 1] = { stage = stage.name, error = result, } end end
-- Ensure proper z-order of adjustable containers tempTimer(0.5, GUI.debugWrap("GUI/INIT/z-order timer", function() -- Bring containers to front in correct order -- Map should be at the back if map and map.container then map.container:show() end if GUI.chatContainer then GUI.chatContainer:show() end if GUI.roomInfoContainer then GUI.roomInfoContainer:show() GUI.roomInfoContainer:raise() -- Bring above map end if GUI.buttonPanelContainer then GUI.buttonPanelContainer:show() GUI.buttonPanelContainer:raise() -- Bring to front end if GUI.actionIconsContainer then GUI.actionIconsContainer:show() GUI.actionIconsContainer:raise() -- Bring to front end end))
-- Preserve the old failure semantics: before diagnostic catching, an error -- prevented this flag from ever being reached. A failed debug run therefore -- remains retryable through "fix gui". GUI.initialized = (#GUI.initFailures == 0) GUI.debug("GUI/INIT", "initialization sequence complete", { initialized = GUI.initialized, failures = GUI.initFailures, }) end
